title: Opossum Snapshot
description: One row, overwritten by the Status sync flow every time OG_opossum_command/status.json changes. The Hub's Now screen and the Morning Briefing read it. Holds only what status.json carries (scrubbed by the app), never step output, paths or links.
rowKey: Title = 'status' (exactly one row; Status sync gets it with $filter=Title eq 'status', creates it on the first run, patches it afterwards)
removedColumns: Carryovers (in the blueprint) is not created: it is not in status.json, and the Hub shows carryovers from the latest 'Opossum Wraps' row (TomorrowCount / Tomorrow), which the 4:30 Wrap writes together with tomorrow.json.
retention: Single row, overwritten in place. Versioning is off so the 15-minute rewrites do not pile up versions.

columns.source: constant 'status' (row key, not from the file)
status.json generatedAt (local time with offset; SharePoint stores the instant in UTC)
length(status.json failed) (runs failed since failedSince; the app caps the array at 20)
length(status.json needsAttention) (the app caps the array at 50)
length(status.json runningNow) (a count; the array itself stays in RawJson)
first(status.json scheduledToday)?['at'] (the app sorts scheduledToday by time; empty array -> null)

the whole status.json text as read (string of the Parse JSON input). Plain multi-line text holds at most 63,999 characters; status.json is normally far smaller. The flow writes the text unchanged when it is at most 63,000 characters and '' otherwise, never a truncated copy (Status sync parses the previous RawJson with json(), and a cut-off text would fail every later run).

views.title: All Items
views.note: Columns are added to the default view by CreateFieldAsXml option 16 (AddFieldToDefaultView); RawJson is created without it.
